about.android_native: Native app package (Capacitor) with background service: title/cover in the media notification and on the lock screen; Bluetooth buttons (A2DP/AVRCP) control Play/Next/Previous. Audio files shared from other apps are imported automatically.
about.android_pwa: Chrome opens the app borderless; Bluetooth output follows the system media output (A2DP). Media Session delivers title/cover to the lock screen; remote controls steer Play/Next/Previous.
about.browser_formats: Supported formats in the browser: MP3, M4A/AAC, OGG/Opus, WAV; FLAC depending on device.
about.ios_native: Native app package (Capacitor) with AVAudioSession: playback continues on the lock screen and in the background. Title/cover appear in Now Playing (Control Center, lock screen); Bluetooth/headset buttons control Play/Next/Previous. Pass audio files to BeatClip via Open in → BeatClip from the Files app. Speakers selectable via AirPlay. Formats: MP3, AAC/M4A, WAV, ALAC, FLAC.
about.ios_pwa: Add to Home Screen installs it as an app. Playback continues on the lock screen; speakers selectable via Control Center → AirPlay. Formats: MP3, AAC/M4A, WAV (FLAC depending on browser).
about.privacy: All files and cuts stay exclusively on this device (IndexedDB, optional persistent storage). No account, no network transfer. Recordings are saved to the library only after stopping; stereo channels can be exported as WAV, MP3 or (in the native app) as M4A.
about.text: Plays locally stored audio files. Each title in a playlist has its own start and end marks – only the section between them is played. Music goes to your speaker via Bluetooth. Microphone recordings and channel export are also possible.

set.bt_help: Connect your Bluetooth speaker in the system settings of your phone (Android: Quick settings → Media output · iPhone: Control Center → AirPlay). BeatClip uses the system audio output – the music automatically plays over the speaker, also on the lock screen.
set.native_hint_android: Title, buttons and Bluetooth controls appear on the lock screen; you can share audio files to BeatClip from any app.
set.native_hint_ios: Title, cover and buttons appear in Now Playing (Control Center, lock screen, AirPlay); you pass audio files via Open in → BeatClip.
set.wa_buf_hint: iOS plays the track past the volume point even though the bridge is active. So the track is additionally decoded into an audio buffer and played from there – the slider and fades then work for sure. If audio stops while the screen is locked: switch this off.
set.wa_gain_hint: iOS ignores the volume of the audio element – this bridge applies volume and fade times through Web Audio. If playback stops or ends abruptly while the screen is locked: switch it off and restart the app.
